definitions: A light, open building or structure, often ornamental, used for shelter, concerts, or exhibitions.
A large, luxurious tent, often with a peaked top, used for events or as a temporary dwelling.
A projecting part of a building, often at the end or in the centre, that is more elaborate or higher than the main part.
In cricket, the main building at a cricket ground, containing the changing rooms, members' areas, and often a viewing balcony.
examples: The garden party was held in one of the grand pavilions.
They erected several pavilions for the festival.
The central pavilion of the stately home was particularly impressive.
The players walked out from the pavilion onto the pitch.
